metadata.description: Claude Code skills and an optional MCP connector for the OpenJev typed-question model.

plugins.name: openjev-skills
plugins.description: Skills that teach Claude Code to prepare data for the OpenJev MCP: state and question formats, tool inputs and outputs, tool chaining, batch items files.

plugins.name: openjev-mcp
plugins.description: Opt-in connector that registers the OpenJev MCP server over HTTP (URL override via OPENJEV_MCP_URL).
